label: common_0990_friend_02
text: Whoa! Down, boy! Don’t jump up like that!\nSeems like hearing your voice has old Mabosstiff\r\nhere all worked up, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_03
text: Oh! But that’s not why I called! Nearly forgot...\nYou remember what we talked about before?\r\nAbout going to Area Zero?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_04a
text: ’Course you do, you little know-it-all! Got a mind\nlike a steel trap, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_04b
text: At least try to take this seriously, would you!\nDon’t you remember our talk at the lighthouse?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_05
text: Well, all the effort you’ve been putting in around\nPaldea has really helped you make a name for\r\nyourself. Built up some good will, that’s for sure.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_06
text: So I’ve been able to secure two allies who want\nto go to Area Zero with us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_07
text: That should have us ready to tackle anything![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_08
text: So now we’ve all just got to get there.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_09
text: First step will be gathering at Area Zero![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_0990_friend_10
text: I’ll be ready and waiting at the Zero Gate—I’ll\nsend you the location on your phone, too.\r\nDon’t leave me hanging forever![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
